explication: Skyvern automates browser workflows with LLM and computer-vision guidance, exposed through a no-code web UI and a Playwright-compatible SDK. A user defines a task or workflow, the API orchestrates planning and browser execution against a target website, then persists run state and artifacts for monitoring. The sampled frontend confirms Axios-backed queries, cached polling for active runs, schedule retrieval, browser-session history, profiles, tags, and copilot chats. Backend internals are represented only at the documented package-directory level because their source was not sampled.
